nodes.label: Pi routed server
nodes.summary: Experimental server routes clients to application-hosted durable Sessions without decoding service business payloads.

nodes.label: RoutedServerServiceHost
nodes.summary: Creates connection-scoped server service endpoints with narrow attachment management.

nodes.label: RoutedSessionHandle
nodes.summary: Presentation-scoped capability invokes opaque service/member envelopes in the selected Session.

nodes.label: Attachment identity fence
nodes.summary: Server-generated attachmentId rejects stale/mismatched routes; one Session may have multiple presentation attachments.

nodes.label: Application Session lifecycle
nodes.summary: Host owns Session discovery, metadata resolution, worker-local Harness and retirement demand.

nodes.label: Pi protocol framing
nodes.summary: CBOR routed-envelope validation and framing are delegated to pi-protocol.

nodes.label: Chord service parsing
nodes.summary: Chord owns service-control grammar, errors, snapshots/updates and subscription encoders.

nodes.label: Unix transport
nodes.summary: Explicit short private socket path and logical serverId route local clients; authentication remains application policy.

nodes.label: Telemetry package introduction
nodes.summary: Callback telemetry context, no-op/reference adapters, conformance suite and typed schemas introduced in 0.84.0.

nodes.label: Explicit child propagation
nodes.summary: Multi-schema typed span starters carry child context explicitly.

nodes.label: Pi telemetry contracts
nodes.summary: Vendor-neutral explicit callback-based span contracts and serializable typed schema utilities.

nodes.label: TelemetryContext
nodes.summary: Starts a span around callback and passes child context explicitly.

nodes.label: TelemetrySpan
nodes.summary: Records attributes, events and status; callback settlement owns span ending.

nodes.label: Passive recording contract
nodes.summary: Recording is synchronous, non-throwing and cannot change business outcome; failed recording is suppressed atomically.

nodes.label: NOOP_TELEMETRY_CONTEXT
nodes.summary: Shared frozen inert span invokes callback synchronously and preserves return/rejection identity without retention.

nodes.label: InMemoryTelemetryContext
nodes.summary: Deterministic detached span snapshots with IDs, parent IDs and end sequence; no timestamps, exporter or bounded retention.

nodes.label: Adapter conformance suite
nodes.summary: Runner-independent suite verifies admission, settlement, parentage, merging and passive failure behavior.

nodes.label: defineTelemetrySchema
nodes.summary: Typed identity helper returns serializable data without runtime validation.

nodes.label: createTypedSpanStarter
nodes.summary: Schema overloads restrict names/attributes/events and provide a child-bound starter.

nodes.label: Completion enrichment
nodes.summary: End attributes are optional normal attributes merged during callback life; not a separate end payload.

nodes.label: Schema metadata
nodes.summary: Describes value sets, sensitivity, cardinality and parent rules; adapters do not enforce schema objects.

nodes.label: Pi package telemetry ownership
nodes.summary: Telemetry owns contracts; pi-ai passes contexts; agent-core owns AI/harness schemas and typed helpers.

nodes.label: Process-local diagnostic state
nodes.summary: Trace contexts/spans must not enter durable records or provider deferred handles.

nodes.label: TUI evolution overview
nodes.summary: Recent releases add color, native clipboard, fullscreen layout/scroll/search, image and render-memory improvements.

nodes.label: Kitty image transcoder
nodes.summary: setImageTranscoder converts JPEG/GIF/WebP to PNG; unavailable or failed conversion uses text fallback.

nodes.label: Weak Markdown token cache
nodes.summary: Parsed tokens are weakly held and cached lines flattened to reduce per-message retained memory.

nodes.label: Terminal color query
nodes.summary: queryTerminalColors queries foreground, background and sixteen ANSI colors in one round trip.

nodes.label: Fullscreen layout introduction
nodes.summary: TuiAltScreen gains VStack/HStack/ScrollView, scrolling, selection, prompt navigation and notifications.

nodes.label: Pi TUI framework
nodes.summary: Component-based terminal UI supports differential rendering, synchronized output and interchangeable main/alternate screen renderers.

nodes.label: TUI interface
nodes.summary: Shared component, focus, overlay, input, lifecycle and rendering contract.

nodes.label: TuiMainScreen
nodes.summary: Main terminal buffer renderer preserves terminal-owned scrollback.

nodes.label: TuiAltScreen
nodes.summary: Fixed-height alternate viewport owns scrolling and restores/prints full final document on stop.

nodes.label: Component
nodes.summary: render(width) emits bounded-width lines; optional input/mouse handlers and required cache invalidate.

nodes.label: VStack and HStack
nodes.summary: Constrained stack entries distribute basis/grow/shrink/min/max and responsive visibility.

nodes.label: ScrollView
nodes.summary: Owns constrained scrolling, follow-end, chain/contain overscroll and primary navigation.

nodes.label: Synchronized output
nodes.summary: CSI 2026 wraps screen updates atomically to suppress flicker.

nodes.label: Overlay handle
nodes.summary: Positioned components have explicit hide/focus/unfocus/bounds APIs and responsive visibility.

nodes.label: Mouse event routing
nodes.summary: Alternate mode normalizes screen/local coordinates, capture, focus, click and wheel; hits use committed geometry.

nodes.label: Focusable and CURSOR_MARKER
nodes.summary: Focused component emits zero-width cursor marker for hardware cursor/IME positioning.

nodes.label: Editor
nodes.summary: Multiline text, autocomplete, file/slash completion, bracketed paste and height-aware scrolling.

nodes.label: Markdown
nodes.summary: Themed Markdown with syntax highlighting and render caches; raw HTML is plain text.

nodes.label: Kitty inline images
nodes.summary: Kitty supports cropped viewport placements; alternate iTerm2 uses placeholders because deletion/cropping is unavailable.

nodes.label: CombinedAutocompleteProvider
nodes.summary: Combines slash commands and file path/@ attachment completion.

nodes.label: Terminal interface
nodes.summary: ProcessTerminal binds stdin/stdout and VirtualTerminal uses headless xterm for testing.

nodes.label: ANSI width utilities
nodes.summary: visibleWidth, truncateToWidth and wrapTextWithAnsi account for escape sequences and styled text.

nodes.label: Color values
nodes.summary: Indexed ANSI, sRGB, OKLCH and OKHSL values convert/mix and render in terminal color modes.

nodes.label: Darwin native clipboard
nodes.summary: AppKit provides asynchronous text/image/file-path clipboard and modifier-key state.

nodes.label: Darwin toolchain
nodes.summary: Apple clang/xcrun SDK or osxcross with SDK and Mach-O linker build arm64 and x64 prebuilds.

nodes.label: Linux native clipboard
nodes.summary: Asynchronous bounded-wait X11 reads use libxcb on glibc/musl x64 and arm64.

nodes.label: Linux clipboard fallback
nodes.summary: Unavailable X11 uses command tools; Wayland uses wl-paste and writes use existing CLI/terminal paths.

nodes.label: Isolated X11 clipboard tests
nodes.summary: Xvfb/xclip tests use isolated servers and skip unavailable dependencies.

nodes.label: Windows native clipboard
nodes.summary: kernel32/user32 provide console setup, modifier state and asynchronous text/image clipboard.

nodes.label: Windows native toolchains
nodes.summary: Visual Studio C++ or MinGW-compatible cross compilers build x64 and arm64.

nodes.label: Opt-in clipboard write test
nodes.summary: PI_TEST_NATIVE_CLIPBOARD test replaces real system clipboard content; only static documentation was read.

nodes.label: Alternate-screen layout plan
nodes.summary: Constrained alternate viewport keeps transcript scrollable and pending/status/widgets/editor/footer fixed in a dock.

nodes.label: Stable component tree
nodes.summary: Stateful components stay alive; internal frame layout boxes rebuild per requested render.

nodes.label: Internal frame geometry
nodes.summary: Transient rectangles, clips, ancestry, source mapping and hit-test state are private to TUI.

nodes.label: Leaf cache reuse
nodes.summary: Reuse Markdown/Text/Image/Box caches; avoid a second framework cache until measurement warrants one.

nodes.label: Axis-neutral allocation
nodes.summary: Stack allocator handles visibility, basis, grow/shrink, min/max and deterministic integer rounding.

nodes.label: Scroll chaining
nodes.summary: Unused wheel delta propagates inner-to-outer or stops at contain; non-scrollable dock falls back to primary transcript.

nodes.label: Focus and wheel separation
nodes.summary: Scrolling regions does not steal editor keyboard focus; cursor mapping includes offsets and scroll translation.

nodes.label: Visible-frame selection
nodes.summary: Selection and OSC8 links use committed composited screen rows with ANSI/grapheme-aware slicing.

nodes.label: Image layout limits
nodes.summary: Preserve vertically clipped Kitty transcript images; general horizontal image composition is out of scope.

nodes.label: Full final document
nodes.summary: Stopping alternate mode renders unbounded full root, strips cursor markers and omits terminal padding.

nodes.label: Coding-agent dock integration
nodes.summary: Stable transcript and footer containers compose flow main screen and viewport alternate screen.

nodes.label: ViewportTUI capability
nodes.summary: Constrained methods are available only through explicit alternate-screen capability and type guard.

nodes.label: Keyboard fallback
nodes.summary: Page/top/bottom navigation remains available without mouse capability detection.
